description: versions.yaml is the third-party SSoT for the DFE stack. Renovate lives HERE (relocated from dfe-docker, which now derives its pins via `make stack`). OPERATOR-COUPLED service versions -- services.clickhouse-version (clickhouse-operator), services.kafka-version (strimzi 0.51 ceiling 4.2.0), services.redpanda-version (redpanda-operator) -- are bounded by the ORG PRESET's allowedVersions rules, which gate by PACKAGE wherever the image is pinned rather than by file: nothing parses versions.yaml, so gating it alone left the same image in a compose file, a CI script or a chart values file wide open. They still move BY HAND in lockstep with their operator, verified against the operator support matrix and `dfe-stack compat-check`; the preset stops Renovate proposing past the ceiling. FOLLOW-UP: the plain-image third-party (kafbat, ferretdb, documentdb-pg, nginx-proxy) will get a Renovate custom regex manager once a `dfe-stack refresh-digests` helper exists to keep services-digests in sync after a version bump (the SSoT splits version and sha256 across services/services-digests, so a version-only bump would strand the digest).
